headline: Leafs place Bo Groulx on waivers
take:
Daily Faceoff reports the Maple Leafs have placed forward Bo Groulx on waivers, noting he has played sparingly for Toronto this season and has yet to register a point. Groulx, drafted 54th overall by the Ducks in 2018 out of Halifax, has played 7 games so far this season.

The numbers back up the quiet stretch. Groulx has averaged 8.04 minutes a game and has no goals or assists. His own expected goals, a measure of the quality of the chances he has taken part in, sit at 0.07, so he has not been robbed of much offense. At 5-on-5, TOR has had 37.93% of the expected goals with him on the ice, and the team's share has been 8.65 points better when he is off it. That is a small sample, but it points to a depth forward who has not moved the play in the right direction. For fantasy purposes, he holds no value as a 0-point player in limited minutes. For the Leafs, the larger issue is a team at 47.7% of expected goals overall, and a roster spot like this one hardly decides that.
